questions.question: Which cells in our body are popularly called "soldiers of the human body”?
questions.solution:

questions.question: The period between ________ in India's history is known as the Delhi Sultanate period.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e __**1206 A.D. and 1526 A.D.**__

 
• **Delhi Sultanate (1206 -1526) **consists of** Islamic rulers.**
 
• It started with the Mamluk (Slave)dynasty and ended with the Lodi dynasty.
 
• **Qutub-Ud-Din-Aibak (Mamluk Dynasty) **was the** first ruler** and **Ibrahim Lodhi (Lodhi Dynasty)** the **last **of Delhi Sultanate.
 
• **Mughal Sultanate (1526 -1857)** started with **Babar (Founder, Battle of Panipat 1) **and ended with** Bahadur Shah II **who was exiled to Myanmar after the 1857 revolt.

questions.question: The amount of light entering the eye can be controlled and regulated by the ______.
questions.solution:
**Parts of an Eye**
 **Function**
 
 

 Cornea
 Cornea along with the lens focuses the light on the retina.
 
 

 Retina
 Is it a screen which converts light to electrochemical signals.
 
 

 Iris
 It is a membrane which controls the pupil. It controls the pupil which in turn controls the light entering.
 
 

 Pupil
 An adjustable opening through which the amount of light entering the eye is adjusted.
 
 

**Note: **The iris opens and closes to control the amount of light entering the eye through the __**pupil**__. The pupil is the opening in the center of the iris where light enters the eye.

questions.question: In 2019, Kazakhstan renamed its capital Astana to ______ .
questions.solution:
• Kazakhstan renamed its capital to **Nur-Sultan **from Asthana** **in 2019.The name of the capital has been changed in honor of the country's President Nur-Sulthan who resigned in 2019.
 
• Kassym-Jomart Tokayev was nominated by Nur-sultan as the next President. Nur-sultan is the "**father** **of the nation**" for Kazakhstan.He lead the nation for 30 years after Soviet Era.
 
• Kazakhstan is the world's **largest** land locked country. 9th largest by area in the world.
 
• Currency is Kazakhstani tenge ( 1 Rupee INR= 5.6 Kazakhstani tenge) as of 2019.
